selection: Supplemental English-language Wikidata organization/institution candidates. Each record retains its QID, English label, English description, source search term, exact entity-search URL, and observed direct P31 instance-of labels. Only records whose direct instance-of label matches the curated organization/institution class allowlist are retained. Legal instruments, publications, products, buildings, geographic places, persons, occupations, transport stops and generic classes are excluded where their direct type is not organizational.
deduplication: Unique QIDs and NFKC/whitespace/case-normalized English labels in this supplement. Integration must also deduplicate against the original 832-record directory by QID and normalized label.
